Q: Can I set PDF resolution (pixels per inch) in react-pdf? A:

There is as stated no DPI in PDF but Adobe allows any custom value, or you can use the Web / System common render @ 1:1 of 96 DPI.

Many PDF viewers allow a user to set to a desired scalar value. But it is not generally adjustable when in the web viewer.

So I support SumatraPDF where that value is a default 96 but can be set by a "High Density" screen user to way beyond 96. But note we are referring to RENDERED hardware output not PDF internals.

So for Web usage there is no common ground 100% zoom or 100DPI are simply irrelevant

Q: How do I convert Hindi Text to UTF-8? A:

The comment from Jaswinder helped fix the issue.

The text is written in a font called "Kruti Dev 010", which is just normal text but displayed as Hindi letters.

By using this Conversion between Krutidev-010 and Unicode tool, I could recover the texts to Unicode.

Q: Word-wrapping a long table cell while maintaining dynamic widths in others A:

It's easy to handle/wrap long words in DIVs and fixed tables (table-layout:fixed) - just apply CSS3 word-wrap:break-words.

Within dynamic tables above property does only half of the work. We need additionally to help the browsers find break points.
